FR-001.title: The site MUST serve a public page per user and calendar year at `/u/{username}/year/{year}`, in the viewer's language, with the same visibility as the dashboard

FR-002.title: `/u/{username}/year` MUST redirect to the most recent year with history, or to the current year when the user has none.

FR-003.title: A year with no history, other than the current year, MUST redirect to `/u/{username}/year`; a non-numeric year, a year before 2000 or after the current year, or

FR-004.title: A year belongs to an episode by the date of its latest watch, as a calendar date in UTC; the page MUST say that rewatches count in the year of their latest watc

FR-005.title: The year's hours, days, fully watched episodes and series MUST follow the dashboard's rules, restricted to watches in that year, so the hours of all years add u

FR-006.title: The most-watched series of the year MUST be the Crunchyroll series with the most minutes watched that year, with its title, a poster (its most-watched matched s

FR-007.title: The page MUST show watch time for each of the 12 months as a chart and name the busiest month (ties to the earlier month).

FR-008.title: Top genres (top 5 plus "Others", shares adding up to 100%), top 3 studios and the format split MUST follow the DNA page's rules (minutes watched, a dub and its

FR-009.title: A series MUST count as new in a year when the earliest watch Frunchy holds for any of its episodes falls in that year, and as continued otherwise; the page show

FR-010.title: The longest streak MUST be the most consecutive calendar days (UTC) in the year with at least one fully watched episode, with its first and last day.

FR-011.title: A year with fewer than 15 fully watched episodes MUST show a "not enough data" state with the count instead of the figures.

FR-012.title: The page MUST list every year with history as a picker, newest first, marking the shown year.

FR-013.title: The dashboard and the DNA page MUST link to `/u/{username}/year`, and the year page MUST link back to both.

FR-014.title: Every figure MUST be computed from stored data when the page is viewed, with no call to MyAnimeList and no new stored data, and MUST be identical after `user-re

FR-015.title: The page MUST NOT show rankings, comparisons with other users, image export or anything without a real data source; every visible text comes from the site's Eng

FR-016.title: The page MUST use the shared design system and components, work from 360px wide in both languages, and meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast.

expectations: no rankings or comparisons with other users
no image export or share cards
no new tables or rewatch ledger
context: constraint: constitution 1.1.1 (no new tables, localized UI, CDN-only)
constraint: feature 004 counting rules and design system
intent: A public per-year review page of a user anime watching, from stored data

decisions.decision: Year = UTC calendar year of the latest watch
decisions.why: only the latest watch per episode is stored; the server has no viewer zone

decisions.decision: Totals undeduplicated, MyAnimeList figures deduplicated, as on the DNA page
decisions.why: years then add up to the dashboard

decisions.decision: Move section, coverageNote, notEnough, shareLine, inv, pctText from Dna.fs into Views/Components.fs
decisions.why: two slices now use them (constitution III)

decisions.decision: Year route segment parsed as text in the handler
decisions.why: one not-found page for bad years and the redirect rules
no new texts, correct in both languages

plan.summary: Plan, research, data model and the year-page contract for a one-slice year review
plan.key_finding: new-versus-continued can only use the latest held watch per episode, so it is an approximation the page must state

tasks.summary: 15 tasks: setup, 4 foundational (texts, icons, shared helpers, DNA), US1 page (4), US2 navigation (2), polish (4)

approach: A new Handlers/Users/Year.fs slice computes one UTC year with one SQL statement using feature 004's rules, plus months, streak and new versus continued series. DNA view helpers move to Views/Components.fs; the dashboard and DNA page link to it.
